title: chylismia claviformis subsp. rubescens
intro: Chylismia claviformis subsp. rubescens, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The Desert Marigold is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Chylismia claviformis subsp. rubescens are thought to include immune system modulation, anti-bacterial and anti-fungal properties, and potential anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among other compounds, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
